label: neiso 43 closeout
definition: neiso-43 closes NEISO: the neiso-41 keeper recipe (rebuilt generic reliability-floor engine, gas-hub-basis-daily overlay, EIA-930 hydro budget) plus a post-solve ORDC scarcity-price overlay with ISO-NE-grounded parameters (VOLL $2000 = Tariff III.1.10.1A offer cap, MCL 1200 MW = Millstone 3 largest contingency, sigma 900 MW = ISO-NE PAF Study 2022); the overlay adds a reserve-shortage adder to econ_prices for capacity economics but leaves dispatch/LP prices unchanged. Determination NOT-YET: caveat budget exceeded (hard 2/1, soft 3/3) — the hard caveats (C1 CC_REGULAR volume, C2 2025 gas +2.8%) both trace to the same EIA-930 gas-cell geothermal/biomass fold-in categorization, not a dispatch error, and the soft caveats (C3c price tail, C5b/C5c storage) trace to the LP's oil-parity cap on cold-hour prices, which the overlay prices for capacity value but does not lift out of the persisted LP prices that drive C3c/C5b/C5c; C6 governance passes.
